description: Work with Ever Gauzy from an MCP client: employees, time tracking, projects and tasks, invoices, expenses, sales pipelines and more, in 324 tools. The server runs locally over stdio from the [ever-gauzy](https://github.com/ever-co/ever-gauzy) repository: build it with `yarn build:mcp:prod` and point your client at `dist/apps/mcp/index.js`. It calls the Gauzy API at `API_BASE_URL`, and signs in with `GAUZY_AUTH_EMAIL` and `GAUZY_AUTH_PASSWORD` when `GAUZY_AUTO_LOGIN` is `true`, or through its `login` tool.
